notes: Seven old kinds kept one-to-one. Archetypes from the Handbook of Mineralogy distribution lists (PDF text via pdftotext), minerals.net halite gallery, GIA (Rogerley), Wikipedia (Blue John, Painite) and a University of Waterloo TV-stone page. Blue John is an archetype under Fluorite. No makers, so no brands; no craft tradition recorded (Blue John working is a candidate tradition but no source on the craft itself was fetched).
